== Biography ==
John Glasgow was born in 1795 in Patrick, Lanarkshire, Scotland. He was married to [[Campbell-61095|Elizabeth (Campbell) Glasgow (1797-1852)]] and had multiple children. John passed away on January 4th, unknown year, likely in the late 1800s given the birth dates of his children. He was a key figure in the family and lived in Lanarkshire for most of his life.<ref>https://www.familysearch.org/library/books/viewer/395015/?offset=1&return=1#page=11&viewer=picture&o=download&n=0&q=father</ref>


A James Glasgow born 1793 is also mentioned - could be a brother, potentially [[Glasgow-1483|James Glasgow (abt.1790-)]]

Fathers name is John
